Freight Tasker Pty Ltd, a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder, is looking for an experienced full-time Software Developer with a background in the logistics industry. You will build the systems that run our forwarding and customs operations, working hands-on with CargoWise, Expedient and modern AI tooling.

About the Company

Freight Tasker Pty Ltd is a digitally forward multi-national freight forwarder with our Australian operations based in Brisbane. Technology sits at the centre of how we operate: we invest in automation, systems integration and practical AI to streamline forwarding and customs workflows, connect with partners and carriers, and deliver a faster, more accurate service to our customers. You will join an on-site team where your work goes straight into daily operations.

About the Role

This is a standalone role for a capable all-rounder who will oversee the technological advancement of the business. You will own our technology roadmap end to end: developing, testing, maintaining and documenting application code in line with user requirements and system and technical specifications, building integrations with our CargoWise and Expedient platforms, and embedding AI across our operations. You will work directly with the leadership team and operational staff, with the autonomy to choose the right tools and set the technical direction.

Key Responsibilities

•	Research, consult and analyse user, business and system requirements, and evaluate existing systems to identify deficiencies and recommend improvements.
•	Design, develop, test, debug, document and maintain program code in accordance with user requirements and system and technical specifications.
•	Build and maintain integrations with CargoWise (eAdapter, APIs, EDI, workflow and registry configuration) and Expedient, including data mapping, message handling and automation.
•	Develop and deploy AI-driven features such as document extraction, classification and workflow automation for logistics operations.
•	Write and maintain technical documentation, program specifications and test plans.
•	Support deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines and operational monitoring of production systems.
•	Identify and address security risks across the product lifecycle.
•	Advise leadership on technology strategy, evaluate emerging tools and platforms, and drive the company's digital roadmap.
•	Train and support operational staff in adopting new systems and AI tooling.


About You 

•	Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or at least 1-2 years of relevant professional experience with strong working knowledge of forwarding, customs and transport operations across air, sea and road.
•	Hands-on experience with CargoWise, including workflow configuration, eAdapter/API integration, EDI messaging or custom development.
•	Demonstrated experience developing with or integrating Expedient freight forwarding and customs software.
•	Experience building AI-enabled software with LangChain and with the models and APIs of all the modern frontier AI labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta and xAI), including intelligent document processing and workflow automation in production systems.
•	Strong experience with AWS for hosting, deployment and cloud services.
•	Strong proficiency in one or more modern languages and frameworks (e.g. Python, C#/.NET, TypeScript/Node, SQL) and experience with REST APIs and EDI.
•	The self-direction to operate as the sole technical resource in the business, managing priorities and delivering without day-to-day technical supervision.
•	Excellent problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to translate operational logistics requirements into robust technical solutions.

What We Offer

•	Salary of $80,000 to $90,000 plus superannuation, commensurate with skills and experience.
•	Real ownership of the systems you build, in a business applying AI to day-to-day freight operations.
•	A collaborative on-site team environment in Brisbane.
•	Ongoing professional development, including support for CargoWise certifications and AI and cloud training.

Navigation Watch:

• Watch Handover to next watch keeper

A Navigational watch can per performed at any time throughout the day or night, they are generally 1.5-2 hours in duration.

• Tender vessel operation
• Launch and retrieval of tender
• Fish Sampling/Chumming
• Maintenance as directed by Vessel Engineer
• Repetitive Manual labour
• Vessel cleaning and house keeping
• Vessel Mooring/Berthing
*This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.

Hours of operation are determined by the daily operational needs,.
January – July Operations are 7 days per week; you can work up to 6 days in a week. Up to 12 hours per day.
August to December Operations are 5 days per week Monday to Friday, you will work up to 5 days in a week, 8 hours per day.
Offshore Operations:
Tow & Support operations begin in December through to late March. If Quota is exhausted quickly the Offshore Operations will cease before late March.
Hours of operation whilst at Sea are from Sunrise to Sunset plus a navigational watch. 

Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Farm work completed inshore and onshore will be calculated at the applicable hourly Farm rate. Aquaculture Award:(https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000114.html)(https://calculate.fairwork.gov.au/payguides/fairwork/ma000114/pdf)
OFFSHORE OPERATIONS
An additional contract is put in place alongside original Deckhand Contract to cover the periods Offshore for Tow & Support operations to classify Duties and Remuneration (there is no Award that covers the "At Sea" roles), contract renumeration is calculated from experience and seamanship knowledge.

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.

Employment Type: Full-Time 38 Hours per week

About Big Michaels Fruit & Vegetables

Big Michael's Fruit & Vegetables is a Wholesale provider to Retail stores, Restaurants, Cafe's, Clubs etc.



Key Responsibilities

The Retail Buyer will be responsible for selecting, purchasing and coordinating the supply of fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce for the business’s retail, wholesale, hospitality and export customers.

Monitor sales data, customer orders, stock levels and product movement to identify purchasing requirements.

Study fresh produce market conditions, seasonal availability, supplier information, pricing trends and supply shortages.

Select and purchase fresh fruit, vegetables and other produce from farmers, growers, wholesalers and market suppliers.

Inspect, compare and assess produce before purchase, including freshness, quality, grading, size, shelf life and suitability for resale or export.

Negotiate purchase prices, quantities, delivery schedules, payment terms, promotional arrangements and supply conditions with suppliers.

Compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability, delivery capacity, freight costs, seasonal availability and consistency of supply.

Prepare buying plans based on customer demand, retail and wholesale orders, budget requirements, seasonal supply and export needs.

Anticipate consumer demand and determine the quantity, quality and variety of produce to be purchased.

Liaise with management regarding long-term purchasing plans, pricing strategies, product promotions and seasonal sales campaigns.

Recommend retail, wholesale and export pricing based on purchase costs, freight costs, market demand, wastage risk and profit margins.

Coordinate product range, promotional stock allocation and merchandising/display strategies with retail and operations staff.

Maintain strong supplier relationships with farmers, growers, wholesalers, market suppliers and transport providers.

Source produce suitable for hospitality customers and export supply, including produce with appropriate freshness, quality, shelf life and transport timing.

Respond to supply disruptions, price increases or poor seasonal availability by identifying alternative suppliers or substitute products.

Work with internal staff to ensure purchased produce is properly received, recorded, quality checked, stored and allocated.

Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier terms, price comparisons, delivery commitments and stock planning information.

Prepare supplier comparison reports, seasonal market updates, purchasing recommendations and stock movement reports.

Travel as required to farms, wholesale markets, supplier premises and regional distribution areas to inspect produce and assess market conditions.



Qualifications and Experience

AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV

At least three years of relevant experience may substitute for the formal training

Relevant qualification in business, retail, supply chain, purchasing, agriculture, fresh produce, food distribution or a related field; and/or

Relevant practical experience in retail buying, fresh produce buying, wholesale purchasing or supply chain purchasing. Minimum 12 months of recent work experience.



Skills and Competencies.

Strong knowledge of fresh produce, seasonality, quality standards and pricing fluctuations.

Strong negotiation skills with farmers, growers, wholesalers and suppliers.

Ability to analyse sales data, customer demand, stock levels and product movement.

Ability to compare suppliers based on price, quality, reliability and delivery capacity.

Understanding of pricing margins, freight costs, promotional planning and wastage risk.

Strong communication and relationship-building skills.

Strong planning, reporting, research and organizational skills.

Ability to travel regularly across metropolitan and regional locations.

Ability to make commercially sound purchasing decisions.

•	Full-Time Fire Protection Equipment Technician

•	Exciting opportunity to work in a professional setting.

About Us
Essential Passive Fire Protection Services Pty Ltd is a proudly Australian-owned and operated company dedicated to delivering premier facility maintenance and safety solutions. We specialise in comprehensive fire protection services, ensuring that commercial, industrial, and residential properties remain safe, compliant, and fully operational. Our commitment to excellence, regulatory compliance, and workplace safety forms the foundation of our operations, enabling us to provide unparalleled service to our diverse client base.

About the role
The Passive Fire Protection Equipment Technician is responsible for ensuring that all passive fire containment systems are correctly installed, inspected, tested, and maintained in strict compliance with the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and applicable Australian Standards, primarily AS 1851. The role involves working with a variety of passive fire systems, including but not limited to fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.

Duties and Responsibilities

•	Install, repair, and maintain passive fire containment systems, including fire-rated batts, wraps, mastic, collars, seals, fire/smoke doors, and shutters.
•	Ensure all installations and maintenance works are executed in accordance with manufacturer specifications, the BCA, and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Select and apply appropriate fire-stopping materials for various penetrations and construction joints.
•	Conduct routine inspections and preventative maintenance testing of passive fire protection systems in accordance with AS 1851.
•	Assess the integrity of fire compartments, fire doors, smoke doors, and fire shutters.
•	Identify, diagnose, and report on defects, non-conformances, or compromised fire separations.
•	Perform necessary rectification and repair works on non-compliant passive fire systems to restore full regulatory compliance.
•	Provide technical recommendations for the upgrade or replacement of obsolete or irreparably damaged passive fire infrastructure.
•	Accurately complete and submit service reports, logbooks, defect notices, and compliance certificates in a timely manner.
•	Maintain comprehensive digital and physical records of all inspections, tests, and rectification works using the company’s designated field service management software.
•	Capture and upload clear photographic evidence of pre- and post-rectification works.
•	Ensure the correct use, maintenance, and storage of all Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), tools, and company vehicles.

Essential Skills

•	Comprehensive understanding of the Building Code of Australia (BCA) and AS 1851 as they relate to passive fire protection.
•	Ability to read, interpret, and work from architectural drawings, engineering plans, and fire matrix schedules.
•	High level of attention to detail and precision in workmanship.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex compliance issues on-site.
•	Proficiency in using mobile technology (tablets/smartphones) and field service management software for reporting and documentation.
•	Excellent time management skills with the capacity to work autonomously and manage a daily schedule of site visits.
•	Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Qualifications needed:

•	Minimum Certificate III level or equivalent relevant work experience
•	Minimum one year of work experience on relevant position
•	White card

What We Offer

•	Competitive salary based on experience
•	Opportunities for professional growth and training
•	A supportive and dynamic work environment
•	Work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technology

Salary:  The role offers a remuneration package ranging from $90,000-$105,000 plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

Vacancy Listing Dates 21/07/2026 to 18/08/2026
- Experienced Professionals wanted!
- Remuneration from $90,000 to $190,000
- Join the team at MLG Oz

MLG Oz is a West Australian owned and operated business with operations located throughout WA and NT.

We are currently looking for Welders / Boilermakers, Motor Mechanics, Diesel Motor Mechanics, Fitters, Metal Fabricators, Industrial Electricians & Auto Electricians across all of our sites.

To be successful in your application, you will need the following:
- Relevant trade qualifications required to perform your duties
- Minimum 3 years' exp. with a demonstrated safety and performance record
- Sound knowledge of workshop and remote site operations
- Experience reading, interpreting, following and communicating information on written job instructions, specifications, standard operating procedures, charts, lists, drawings and other applicable reference documents
- Demonstrated ability to work in multi-disciplinary work teams

You will be required to:
- Undertake repairs and servicing to MLG Oz plant and equipment as indicated by the site supervisor
- Maintain applicable service and operation records
- Order material and parts required for repairs and servicing of oxy and welding plant and equipment in consultation with the Leading Hand and Purchasing Officer/Store person
- Test run site plant and equipment following repairs
- Liaise with the Leading Hand and Site Supervisor on plant and equipment repairs
- Ensure your work environment is maintained through daily housekeeping and equipment inspections
- Take reasonable care to ensure your personal safety and health and that of other personnel whilst in the workplace
- Undertake any other works as directed by the Workshop Supervisor, within your skills and abilities
- Comply with policies, procedures and all safety requirements of MLG Oz and their client whilst on site
- Facilitate the achievement of MLG Oz's goals and objectives relevant to the Kalgoorlie Workshop

We are also currently seeking an experienced Mining Engineer to join our team in Goldfields.

In this role you will be responsible for the development of plans and techniques to meet our mining operations clients' needs. The role will manage assigned projects from start-to-finish, including design and documentation of equipment specifications. In addition, the Engineer will complete all tasks assigned by the Project Manager and/or Civil Manager, assisting with project specific reviews, conducting research, and writing reports. The intent of the role is to support operations in striving towards standardisation of tasks, removal of waste processes, increasing productivity and reduction of costs.

You will be expected to ensure that projects are completed on-time, within the allocated budget, and are resourced accordingly. There will be travel to client facilities to oversee implementation and ongoing reporting and compliance.

Tasks include, but are not limited to:
- Always observe company health and safety requirements and regulations
- Establish professional relationships with staff
- Maintain a high degree of professionalism and diligence
- Prepare plans with detailed drawings that include project specifications and cost estimates
- Design and execute engineering experiments to create workable solutions
- Develop engineering calculations, diagrams and technical reports
- Complete required technical and regulatory documents
- Ensure projects are completed on time and within the specified budget
- Present analysis results and project solutions to technical leads, senior leaders and clients as necessary
- Identify areas where improvements and savings could be made, or efficiencies generated
- Travel to sites operations as required

To be considered for this role, the successful applicant will possess:
- 3+ years' related work exp.
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, design or electrical engineering
- Drivers Licence
- Initiative in problem solving within assigned tasks
- Able to perform effectively within a team environment
- Demonstrated proficiency in written and verbal communication, including creating and delivering presentations
- Advanced skills in critical software applications
- Expertise in data and problem analysis, creative problem solving and design thinking

Additionally, we are seeking a Civil Engineer to join our team. Applicants must have at least 3 years' related work exp. and hold a Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, design or electrical engineering.

The Civil Engineer will be responsible for the development of plans and techniques to meet our mining operations clients' needs. The role will manage assigned projects from start-to-finish, including design and documentation of equipment specifications. In addition, the Engineer will complete all tasks assigned by the Project Manager and/or Civil Manager, assisting with project specific reviews, conducting research, and writing reports. The intent of the role is to support operations in striving towards standardisation of tasks, removal of waste processes, increasing productivity and reduction of costs.

Remuneration packages from $90,000 - $190,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

We are also seeking an experienced Occupational Health and Safety Inspector / HSE Advisor to join our site based Crushing and Screening operations.

To be successful in your application, you will need the following:
- Certificate IV OHS
- Section 44 Appointed Person
- Ability to pass a Pre-employment medical, incl. Drug & Alcohol screen
- 3+ years' experience in system and documentation development
- Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages, particularly Word and Excel
- A high attention to detail to ensure high quality work outcomes.

The following will also be highly regarded:
- Diploma of Occupational/Workplace Health and Safety
- 3+ years relevant mine site experience/crushing plants
- Previous machine operator experience.
- Cert IV Training and Assessment.

A remuneration package between $90,000 - $130,000 will be offered to the successful candidate

We are also seeking Drainers to join our team. You will play a key role in the installation, maintenance, and repair of drainage systems on civil and mining projects. This position involves working in remote environments as part of a skilled wider-earthworks crew, ensuring all drainage infrastructure is constructed to specification, safely, and efficiently. You will be expected to have strong experience in trenching, pipe laying, Tailings Storage Facilities and reading construction plans, along with a solid understanding of site safety standards and environmental considerations. You will be expected to operate machines at times on drainage jobs but also when drainage works are intermittent on the rest of the project.

The role requires adaptability to demanding site conditions and a commitment to high-quality workmanship while maintaining productivity targets. A proactive attitude, strong teamwork skills, and the ability to work long shifts in remote FIFO conditions are essential for success in this role.

You will also need to demonstrate a minimum of 3 years work exp.

Responsibilities:
- Install underground drainage systems, including stormwater, subsoil drainage, and TSF infrastructure
- Read and interpret engineering drawings and site plans
- Ideally be able to set out pipe alignments and levels using lasers and surveying equipment
- Excavate trenches and prepare bedding materials
- Lay pipes, align joints, and ensure correct gradients
- Backfill and compact trenches to specification
- Conduct inspections and testing of installed systems
- Operate and work around heavy machinery safely - during drainage works and during other TSF project works.
- Maintain tools, equipment, and a clean work environment

A remuneration package between $90,000 - $110,000 will be offered .
